bib.title: An Efficient Recipe for Long Context Extension via Middle-Focused Positional Encoding

read.skipped: Reference list skimmed; Appendix A/B derivations (RoPE, truncated Gaussian proof) not recorded in detail; LongBench subtask tables 9-11 not transcribed.

question: Can a pre-trained LLM be extended to a much longer context by fine-tuning only at its pre-trained window while still using information in the middle of the context?
hypothesis: Sampling the middle-segment position indices from a truncated Gaussian, while keeping both continuity and relativity of position indices, improves middle-of-context retrieval at no extra fine-tuning length.
contributions: CREAM: position-index manipulation balancing continuity (short head/tail k=32) and relativity (head/tail N/3) with truncated Gaussian middle sampling
Fine-tunes at 4K and extends Llama-2-7B to 32K, up to 256K; CREAM-Chat needs 100 steps
Outperforms PoSE/RandPos on Lost-in-the-Middle, LongChat-Lines, LongBench

method._comment: Required for empirical, system and benchmark. Put every number the paper gives; a field it does not give is null. `trains` says whether the work trains or fine-tunes anything: when false, the training block stays null and the reproducibility score counts the inference and eval fields instead. `other` holds anything that matters for a rerun and has no slot.
method.summary: Fine-tunes Llama-2-7B (Base on Pile samples >4K tokens, 1,000 steps; Chat on concatenated ShareGPT, 100 steps) with position indices rewritten so a 4K sequence covers head, middle, tail segments spread over the target length L. Middle segment position drawn from a truncated Gaussian; combined with Linear, NTK or YaRN interpolation.
method.task: context window extension via positional interpolation fine-tuning

datasets.name: The Pile (subset from Zhu et al. 2023)
ShareGPT (Vicuna unfiltered)
datasets.preprocessing: Vicuna prompt template, concatenated until each point >=4K tokens; loss only on ASSISTANT part

datasets.name: Lost in the Middle key-value retrieval
datasets.size: 500 samples per position; 75 keys (~5K tokens) and 140 keys (~10K tokens)

training.hardware: 2x A100-80G, DeepSpeed ZeRO stage 1, Flash Attention-2
training.wall_clock: about 6 hours (Base, 1,000 steps); about 2 hours (Chat, 100 steps)

other.head_tail_modes: k and N/3 sampled with equal probability
other.interpolation: Linear unless stated; NTK, YaRN also

inference.samples: 50 samples per length (LongChat-Lines), 500 per position (Lost in the Middle)

eval.protocol: single run; no seeds or significance tests stated

evidence.quote: A learning rate of 2 × 10−5 with a linear scheduler is adopted

results.claim: CREAM-YaRN beats PoSE-YaRN on Lost in the Middle by over 20% on average

limits: Position interpolation loses information when fine-tuning only at the pre-trained length.
Authors concede decoder-only models inherently show a U-shaped curve, so lost-in-the-middle is not solved.
Single runs, no seeds or significance tests; evaluation mostly on 7B Llama-2 models.
Table 1 shows middle accuracy still far below edges, notably at 140 keys.
PoSE numbers in Table 6 come from a different base (LLaMa 1-7B, 2K) so are reference only.
